# VDC (Vehicle Dynamic Control) switch wiring and setup

> **[Unverified]** This page rests on a single community report. Cross-check before relying on it.

> Items marked **[Partial]** are only partly confirmed by the source and need more work. They stay in the review queue and are firmed up, corrected or removed as more sources come in.

## Summary

[Partial] Determine circuit type and connect specific pins with wires for VDC switch illumination. [t751]

## Procedure

> **[Partial]** Needs more work: the verifier could confirm only part of this procedure (the steps marked [Partial], or whether the list is complete). Steps or precautions may be wrong or missing; read the source thread before relying on it. Later runs fill it in as more sources are found.

1. Determine the circuit type by checking for 'v2' on the artwork, indicating a momentary v2 circuit.
2. Connect Pin 10 with RED wire if you want the lower light illuminated.
3. Connect Pin 9 with BROWN wire if you want the lower light illuminated.
4. [Partial] Connect Pin 8 with RED wire for illumination purposes.
5. [Partial] Connect Pin 7 with BROWN wire for illumination purposes.
6. Wire Pin 2 to one of the remaining wires from the computer control side.
7. Wire Pin 3 to the last remaining wire from the computer control side.

_Procedure reported by [t751]. Photos of this job are in the source: <https://www.xterranation.org/index.php?threads/how-to-swap-stock-switches-to-otrattw-switches.5311/>_

## Tools

- [Partial] Multimeter or power probe [t751]

## Tips & gotchas

- If you do not have Brown and Red going directly to the switch, use a multimeter with dimmer on max to find the wires. [t751]
- Use female connectors for easier installation without cutting factory plugs. [t751]
